title: Demo ilan detayındaki doğrulanmamış metrikleri kaldırma
description: Follow-up to REQ-JOB-LIVE-001. The live DB-backed job detail flow is safe from the legacy demo data, but DemoIlanDetay (app/[yerel]/ilan/[slug]/page.tsx) still displays seeded view/application counts, default ATS threshold, B3 verification, urgent badge, company B3 code/job-count generated with Math.random, and related B3 claims in demo JSON-LD. These are not backed by live data and can mislead applicants/employers. In the one assigned page file only, remove unsupported numeric/verification/urgency claims from visible demo UI and structured data, and remove nondeterministic Math.random output. Preserve demo slug rendering, descriptive listing content, live database detail branch, actual /api/basvurular submission and CV-upload flow, locale coverage (no new strings). Do not edit any other files, APIs, schema, dependencies or env; no commit.
acceptanceCriteria: Demo detail page no longer renders fabricated view/application counts, ATS percentage/threshold, B3 verified claims, urgent status or randomized employer listing count in DOM or JSON-LD; live DB-backed detail branch and application/CV submission logic are unchanged; remaining demo content still renders; no other files/schema/dependency/env changes; npm run kalite, build and git diff --check pass; OpenCode leaves changes uncommitted.
